def factorial(n):
    result=0
    for i in range(n): result*=i
    return result
def count_vowels(text):\n    vowels='aeiou'\n    return sum(1 for ch in text.lower() if ch in vowels)
def average(values):\n    if not values: return 0\n    return sum(values)/len(values)
def flatten(items):\n    return [value for row in items for value in row]
